blocks.text: Professional Painters in Redmond
Step 1: Request a Free Home Interior Painting Estimate

At EA Pro Painters, the first step is always a consultation. Get a free interior painting project estimate online or call us at (206) 250-1194. Our painting experts will visit your home and assess the areas that need work. During this step, we will discuss your vision, color preferences, and any specific requirements you might have. Based on your needs, we will provide you with a detailed estimate. Additionally, our experts will help determine how much paint is needed for the project to ensure efficiency and avoid wastage.

blocks.text: Step 2: Choose Your Paint Colors

Selecting the right colors for your painting project can be overwhelming, especially when you have a wide range of options. Using new paint to cover existing colors and selecting the right paint colors for the desired look is crucial. Our team offers expert color consultation to help you select shades. We consider lighting, as colors can look different under various lighting conditions. Lastly, we recommend the best palettes and finishes that match your furniture and overall decor theme.

blocks.text: Step 3: Plan and Prepare with Drop Cloths

After we agree on your budget and color choices, we move on to the planning and preparation. We will finalize timelines and provide an overview of the project milestones. We will also help you protect all furniture and personal belongings by moving larger pieces to the center of the room and covering them with durable plastic sheets. We clean the surfaces to ensure that the paint will adhere well. Our preparation also involves priming the walls to help achieve a uniform finish and enhance the paint’s durability.
